en.p: As shown in the figure, there are an ellipse $C_1:\ \dfrac{x^{2}}{a^{2}}+y^{2}=1$ with foci $\mathrm{F}(c,\,0)$ and $\mathrm{F'}(-c,\,0)\ (c>0)$, and an ellipse $C_2$ with foci $\mathrm{G}(0,\,d)$ and $\mathrm{G'}(0,\,-d)\ (d>1)$ that passes through the two vertices of ellipse $C_1$. Let $\mathrm{P}$ be the point in the first quadrant where line $\mathrm{FG}$ meets ellipse $C_1$, and let $\mathrm{Q}$ be the point in the first quadrant where line $\mathrm{F'P}$ meets ellipse $C_2$.

When $\overline{\mathrm{GP}}=\overline{\mathrm{PF}}$ and $\overline{\mathrm{GP}}+\overline{\mathrm{PF'}}=2\sqrt{2}$, what is the value of $\overline{\mathrm{QG}}+\overline{\mathrm{QG'}}$? (Here $a$ is a positive number.) [4 points]
